    AI Overview
    The McDonald's HUNTR/X Meal, launched March 31, 2026, as part of the "KPop Demon Hunters" collaboration, features 10-piece Chicken McNuggets, Ramyeon McShaker Fries (with soy/garlic/spice seasoning), Demon Sauce (purple mustard), Hunter Sauce (sweet chili), and a medium drink. It includes exclusive HUNTR/X collectible photocards. 
    Key Details of the HUNTR/X Meal: 
    • Main: 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
    • Sides: Ramyeon McShaker Fries—fries with a special seasoning mix (soy, garlic, sesame, and spice) to be shaken in a bag.
    • Sauces: Includes two limited-time sauces: Demon Sauce (a creamy, bold purple mustard) and Hunter Sauce (a sweet chili sauce).
    • Drink: Medium soft drink.
    • Collectibles: Each meal comes with a pack of two [KPop Demon Hunters] photocards and a Derpy access card.
    • Availability: Released in the USA on March 31, 2026, for a limited time. 
    A separate, limited-time "Derpy McFlurry" featuring vanilla soft serve with berry popping pearls is also available, along with the "Saja Boys" breakfast meal option.
